summary: Reconciled proposal and functionality document; independently inspected all proposed code citation ranges and all upstream contradiction ranges. Four changes supported; five compiled-layout claims appropriately deferred. Retained research inherited without cosmetic rewriting.

proposed_facts.reason: The canonical adapter delegates matching-reference cleanup, and its separate Matadogas registration supports replacing the rendered Logic31 hypothesis with a descriptive cleanup name.

Canonical code confirms command gating, pre-decrement exact-zero testing, interval reload before one selected spawn attempt, and a nullable creation result. The correction preserves failure and nonpositive-countdown behavior.

The state table and callbacks distinguish state index 2 from animation ID -1. Context confirms velocity reset and startup processing; the shared state-change callback reset explains why transition to state 0 ends accessory emission.

The sampled angle affects planar velocity, whereas initial position uses the parent's ECB midpoint. Both gas effect initializers use unit scale. The replacement explicitly avoids inferring compiled constant-pool membership or attack parameters.

contradictions.reason: Accepted deferral of all five compiled-section claims: source arrays, assertion strings, and numeric operations cannot establish section sizes, ordering, alignment, padding, string placement, or constant-pool membership. No compiled evidence was supplied.
The Logic31 naming contradiction is resolved by proposal fact 0: the parent has its own registration and its adapter performs reference cleanup. No replacement historical logic number is asserted.

The vague activation explanation is resolved by proposal fact 2: activation resets velocity and installs an independently gated emitter; the later state transition clears that accessory callback through shared engine code.
The guaranteed-child claim is resolved by proposal fact 1: countdown reload precedes a spawn attempt whose result may be null, and expiry requires exact zero after decrement.
The randomized-placement claim is resolved by proposal fact 3: position and randomized launch velocity are computed separately. Compiled-pool attribution remains explicitly deferred.
